question: dame el volumen liquidado en euros de cada mes junto con la diferencia respecto al mes anterior, ordenado por mes
sql:
SELECT d.month, SUM(fps.net_eur_minor) AS volume_eur, LAG(SUM(fps.net_eur_minor)) OVER (ORDER BY d.month) - SUM(fps.net_eur_minor) AS diff_from_prev_month
FROM fact_settlement_batch fps
JOIN dim_date d ON fps.settlement_date = d.full_date
GROUP BY d.month
ORDER BY d.month
